title: 0069 간편 플래너 여러 업체 공통 줄 — 줄 유전체 · 공통 줄(3곳 이상 · 씨앗) · 씨앗 설계, 셋 다 서버만
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'partner', 'probe X', 'expert', 'active'), ({{company_y}}, 'partner', 'probe Y', 'agent', 'active'), ({{company_z}}, 'partner', 'probe Z', 'manager', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.company_members (company_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES ({{company_x}}, {{x_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active')

INSERT INTO public.planner_drafts (company_id, id, model, created_by) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'd-probe-a', '{"walls":[]}'::jsonb, {{x_owner_user}}), ({{company_x}}, 'd-probe-b', '{"walls":[]}'::jsonb, {{x_owner_user}})

INSERT INTO public.planner_draft_genome (company_id, draft_id, rev, item, lines) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'd-probe-a', 1, 'sink', '[{"k":"floor","fx":["sink"],"cells":[{"l":[],"r":["LB-DR3-600"],"w":900},{"l":[],"r":[],"w":600}]}]'::jsonb)

INSERT INTO public.planner_genome_panel (item, kind, line_key, line, company_ids, n, seed) VALUES ('sink', 'floor', 'probe-key-3', '{"fx":["sink"],"cells":[]}'::jsonb, ARRAY[{{company_x}}, {{company_y}}, {{company_z}}]::uuid[], 3, false), ('sink', 'floor', 'probe-key-seed', '{"fx":[],"cells":[]}'::jsonb, ARRAY[{{company_x}}]::uuid[], 1, true)
INSERT INTO public.planner_genome_seeds (company_id, draft_id, marked_by) VALUES ({{company_x}}, 'd-probe-a', {{hq_user}})

checks.name: 줄 유전체 · 공통 줄 · 씨앗 읽기 — 서버만 (익명 · 구성원 deny)
checks.sql: select (select count(*) from public.planner_draft_genome where company_id = {{company_x}}) + (select count(*) from public.planner_genome_panel where line_key like 'probe-key-%') + (select count(*) from public.planner_genome_seeds where company_id = {{company_x}})

checks.name: 구성원은 줄 유전체를 쓰지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.planner_draft_genome (company_id, draft_id, rev, item, lines) values ({{company_x}}, 'd-probe-b', 1, 'sink', '[]'::jsonb)

checks.name: 서버는 줄 유전체를 넣는다
checks.sql: insert into public.planner_draft_genome (company_id, draft_id, rev, item, lines) values ({{company_x}}, 'd-probe-b', 1, 'sink', '[]'::jsonb)

checks.name: 남의 업체 설계에는 줄 유전체를 붙이지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.planner_draft_genome (company_id, draft_id, rev, item, lines) values ({{company_y}}, 'd-probe-a', 1, 'sink', '[]'::jsonb)

checks.name: 줄 유전체 — 배열이 아니면 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.planner_draft_genome (company_id, draft_id, rev, item, lines) values ({{company_x}}, 'd-probe-b', 1, 'sink', '{}'::jsonb)

checks.name: 줄 유전체 — 다시 보내면 서버가 고친다
checks.sql: update public.planner_draft_genome set rev = 2, lines = '[]'::jsonb where company_id = {{company_x}} and draft_id = 'd-probe-a'

checks.name: 줄 유전체 지우기는 서버도 못 한다
공통 줄 — 3곳 미만은 씨앗이 아니면 넣지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.planner_genome_panel (item, kind, line_key, line, company_ids, n, seed) values ('sink', 'floor', 'probe-key-2', '{}'::jsonb, ARRAY[{{company_x}}, {{company_y}}]::uuid[], 2, false)

checks.name: 공통 줄 — 업체 수가 업체 목록과 다르면 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.planner_genome_panel (item, kind, line_key, line, company_ids, n, seed) values ('sink', 'floor', 'probe-key-n', '{}'::jsonb, ARRAY[{{company_x}}, {{company_y}}, {{company_z}}]::uuid[], 5, false)

checks.name: 공통 줄 — 모르는 줄 종류는 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.planner_genome_panel (item, kind, line_key, line, company_ids, n, seed) values ('sink', 'stack', 'probe-key-k', '{}'::jsonb, ARRAY[{{company_x}}, {{company_y}}, {{company_z}}]::uuid[], 3, false)

checks.name: 공통 줄 — 다시 묶을 때 서버가 지운다
checks.sql: delete from public.planner_genome_panel where line_key like 'probe-key-%'

checks.name: 공통 줄 — 구성원은 넣지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.planner_genome_panel (item, kind, line_key, line, company_ids, n, seed) values ('sink', 'floor', 'probe-key-m', '{}'::jsonb, ARRAY[{{company_x}}]::uuid[], 1, true)

checks.name: 씨앗 — 표시를 빼는 것은 서버가 한다
checks.sql: delete from public.planner_genome_seeds where company_id = {{company_x}} and draft_id = 'd-probe-a'

checks.name: 씨앗 — 고치기는 서버도 못 한다
checks.sql: update public.planner_genome_seeds set marked_by = null where company_id = {{company_x}}
